mapper.sql: a.id, a.area_code, a.area_name, a.maintainer_id, m.name AS maintainer_name, a.center_latitude, a.center_longitude, a.radius_m, a.boundary_json, a.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant p WHERE p.area_id = a.id) AS plant_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plant_area a LEFT JOIN maintainer m ON m.id = a.maintainer_id ORDER BY a.id ASC
SELECT FROM plant_area a LEFT JOIN maintainer m ON m.id = a.maintainer_id WHERE a.area_code = #{areaCode}
SELECT FROM plant_area a LEFT JOIN maintainer m ON m.id = a.maintainer_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plant_area (area_code, area_name, maintainer_id, center_latitude, center_longitude, radius_m) VALUES (#{areaCode}, #{areaName}, #{maintainerId}, #{centerLatitude}, #{centerLongitude}, #{radiusM}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE area_name = VALUES(area_name), maintainer_id = VALUES(maintainer_id), center_latitude = VALUES(center_latitude), center_longitude = VALUES(center_longitude), radius_m = VALUES(radius_m)
mapper.update: UPDATE plant_area SET area_code = #{areaCode}, area_name = #{areaName}, maintainer_id = #{maintainerId}, center_latitude = #{centerLatitude}, center_longitude = #{centerLongitude}, radius_m = #{radiusM}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE plant SET area_id = NULL WHERE area_id = #{areaId}
